岗哨 Watchpost

用 iPhone 回看自己服务器上的录像。

tesla-sentry-f50 的原生 iPhone 查看器。填入服务器地址和管理员密码即可连接；没有服务器，也能体验内置演示。

找到事件

按日期浏览哨兵片段、保存片段和最近片段。

跟着录像回看

在事件已有的镜头之间切换，查看片段中记录的车况读数。

导出一段录像

由服务器生成单分钟、单镜头的带水印视频，再保存或分享。

需要 iOS 18 或更高版本；查看真实录像需自备兼容的 tesla-sentry-f50 服务器。

即将登陆 App Store。

独立项目，与 Tesla, Inc. 无关联。

Watchpost

See the recordings on your own server.

A native iPhone viewer for tesla-sentry-f50. Connect with your server address and admin password, or try the built-in demo without a server.

Find the event

Browse Sentry, Saved and Recent clips by date.

Follow the recording

Switch between the cameras recorded for that event. View the driving readings available in the clip.

Export one clip

Ask your server for one watermarked minute from one camera, then save or share the video.

Requires iOS 18 or later and your own compatible tesla-sentry-f50 server for real recordings.

Coming soon to the App Store.

Independent project. Not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.
